_comment: Hand-maintained input to `pnpm identities`. The bootstrap treats one
normalised name as one sailor by default (this corpus is small enough that
it holds); this file records the cross-spelling merges the matcher cannot
see, and the exceptions to that default. See CLARIFICATIONS.md §6.
unify    - one sailor published under several spellings. `name` is the
display name; `aliases` are the other spellings as published.
A group with no aliases is a rename: it fixes a display name
without changing which rows group together.
separate - a name that really is two different sailors, so the
one-name-one-sailor default must not merge them.
Display names follow the most recently published spelling, on the grounds
that it is the scorer's latest word on it — except where an earlier form is
strictly fuller, since dropping part of a double-barrelled surname is a
loss rather than a correction. Only Caoilinn Geraghty-McDonnell hits that
exception, and it is the one display choice still worth confirming.
Do not add a merge on a hunch. Under-linking splits one sailor's record;
over-linking puts another sailor's results in it, which is the worse error
and the harder one to notice.

unify.name: Cora Naughton
unify.note: Blessington SC, 420, helming both years with Isha Duggan crewing both years. Confirmed one sailor.

unify.name: Daniel Copithorne
unify.note: Schull, helming both years. The 2024 page drops the second i; the same page drops it from Lucy Copithorne too, so it is one scorer's spelling, not two families. Confirmed one sailor.

unify.name: Lucy Copithorne
unify.note: Schull, crewing for Ryan O'Driscoll both years. Same dropped i as Daniel Copithorne on the same page. Confirmed one sailor.

unify.name: Ryan O'Driscoll
unify.note: Schull, helming both years with Lucy Copithorne crewing. The 2024 page drops the apostrophe. Confirmed one sailor.

unify.name: Caoilinn Geraghty-McDonnell
unify.note: Crewed for Riona McMorrow Moriarty in 2024, helmed in 2025. Confirmed one sailor. The 2024 form is kept as the display name because it is the fuller one — the 2025 page keeps only the second half of the surname. Worth confirming which the sailor uses.
